task: T16 synthetic measurement archive and archive-only recalculation
scope: Synthetic-only evidence. No real database, registry, deployment, OS setting, clock, schema, or writer was modified.

implementation.archive_reader: Separate Python process takes only the archive path, receives a reduced environment, and does not connect to Docker, PostgreSQL, or MLflow.
implementation.numeric_policy: 50 warmup rows excluded; all 1,000 measured rows used; nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n)-1; request IDs and journal/report latency joined by ID.
safety: Output path must be new and inside 261021/data/reports.
Source root must be the current-user-owned private harness temp directory and carry a mode-0600 random identity marker.
Only four exact source originals are copied byte-for-byte; source files are checked before and after copying.
No extractall; duplicate, extra, missing, symlink, traversal, oversized, compressed, or hash-mismatched ZIP members are rejected.
Credential-like fields, raw environment/commandline fields, credential URI, non-local URI, and absolute filesystem path are rejected.
An export or verifier failure removes its newly created output directory; harness cleanup still runs in finally.
If disposable-resource cleanup fails after export, the archive directory is removed and the failure is propagated.

local_synthetic_run.timing_capture_limitation: The first harness run was invoked directly through the execution tool; its process start/end UTC and MONOTONIC were not captured and are not reconstructed. A second independent full run below has wrapper-captured UTC/MONOTONIC, exit and log hash.

repeat_synthetic_run.interpretation: The 80.1427 ms and 86.1517 ms p95 values are separate synthetic attempts. Neither is selected as a preferred run or represented as production performance.

standalone_recheck.result: 1,050 journal responses matched report request IDs and latency; 1,000 measured rows recomputed to p95 80.14272799482569 ms.
